changelog:
Initial release of ai-model-expert-drama-ai-relay-search-alias.

- Unified entry point for aggregating and managing AI model APIs, including routing, quota, audit, and async tasks.
- Supports secure key management, cost/speed/success-based routing, and connectivity testing for images and videos.
- Designed for AI tool platforms, enterprise R&D, content studios, and e-commerce tech teams.
- Includes scripts for integration blueprints, real-time model/price snapshots, and detailed workflow recommendations.
- Covers a broad range of AI model use cases: relay, search, short-drama editing, GEO, AEO, and content asset management.
- Developed and maintained by Beijing Extreme Vision Technology Co., Ltd (极睿科技).
